_help: Camera chips on the Video screen. Each chip has a phrase per video model: Wan follows its official short 'the camera ...' style, LTX wants how and when the camera moves. 'exclusive' chips cannot be combined with others. See docs/PROMPT_AUDIT.md (P5).

camera.label: Static
camera.wan: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move.
camera.ltx: The camera holds a locked-off static shot for the whole clip.

camera.label: Slow push-in
camera.wan: The camera slowly pushes in toward the subject.
camera.ltx: The camera slowly pushes in toward the subject until it fills most of the frame.

camera.label: Pull back
camera.wan: The camera slowly pulls back to reveal more of the scene.
camera.ltx: The camera slowly pulls back, gradually revealing more of the surroundings.

camera.label: Orbit
camera.wan: The camera slowly orbits around the subject.
camera.ltx: The camera orbits slowly around the subject, keeping it centred in the frame.

camera.label: Pan left
camera.wan: The camera pans slowly to the left.
camera.ltx: The camera pans slowly to the left, revealing more of the scene on that side.

camera.label: Handheld
camera.wan: Handheld camera with subtle natural shake.
camera.ltx: The shot is handheld, with subtle natural camera shake throughout.
